fr.mieuxvoter:kmj-android 0.4.1 发布, A Kotlin Multiplatform library to efficiently rank candidates using Majority Judgment.
Majority Judgment is an elegant voting system used in french wine contests, among other things.
Its resolution does not require a computer, but it's still handy to be able to do it digitally.

This library supports arbitrarily large amounts of voters — and millions of candidates.
In addition to ranking, it also provides an extensive analysis of the merit profiles,
including a scalar majority merit value that can be useful in a number of ways.

For impeccable accuracy and reliability, this library does not use floating-point numbers.
It also provides three utilities to balance your tallies, including a Least-Common-Multiple-based normalization.

items.title:
eu.exeris:exeris-sdk-source-model-io 0.12.0 发布, JavaParser-based reader (.java → DomainMetadata) and idempotent writer
        (DomainMetadata → .java, preserving user comments, formatting, and
        non-Exeris annotations) for the canonical source model. Per ADR-037 this
        is a separate module so JavaParser stays off the dependency tree of

items.title:
eu.exeris:exeris-sdk-composition-runtime 0.12.0 发布, Boot-time composition library (ADR-024 obligations 8a/8a'). A generic, once-tested
        library every SKU bootstrap invokes at startup: the validation-stamp assertion checks the
        tooling-emitted stamp in cap-manifest.json (presence, well-formedness,
        content-binding-match, version-match) and fails fast on drift, then the boot conductor
        drives each cap's four-phase lifecycle (CapabilityLifecycleHooks from
        exeris-sdk-composition-lifecycle) in the manifest initOrder — invoked by the SKU
        bootstrap after KERNEL READY, never a kernel Subsystem. It does NOT re-validate (no
        @Requires->@Provides DAG re-resolution). The binding it recomputes is the ONE canonical
        definition in exeris-sdk-composition-spec (obligation 8b) — no verbatim port. Ships into
        the SKU jar; carries no kernel or codegen dependency (obligation 9 — the kernel stays
        cap-blind; the build-time pipeline is not dragged onto the SKU classpath).

com.enrichmeai.culvert:data-pipeline-it-support 0.3.0 发布, Reusable Testcontainers fixtures for the Culvert framework's
        integration tests. Provides emulator containers (BigQuery via
        goccy/bigquery-emulator, GCS via fsouza/fake-gcs-server) plus
        helpers that build GCP SDK clients pointed at those emulators.
        Pub/Sub uses Testcontainers' built-in PubSubEmulatorContainer
        directly (no wrapper needed) — see the module README.

        This is a TEST-SUPPORT LIBRARY: dependencies are declared in
        compile scope so consumer modules can put it in test scope and
        inherit Testcontainers + JUnit Jupiter transitively into their
        own *IT.java tests. The fixtures are exercised under the parent's
        `it` profile (failsafe, *IT.java) against a running Docker daemon.
        Sprint-10 deliverable (T10.1).

com.enrichmeai.culvert:data-pipeline-gcp-observability 0.3.0 发布, Google Cloud observability adapters for the Culvert framework. Provides
        CloudTraceObservabilityHook (ObservabilityHook backed by OpenTelemetry
        exporting spans to Cloud Trace via the GCP exporter) and
        CloudMonitoringMetricsHook (StageMetricsHook backed by Cloud
        Monitoring), both registered via java.util.ServiceLoader. Sprint-2
        deliverable (issue #24). Multi-contract module — same shape as the
        bigquery-java pilot which ships three contract impls under one pom.

        NO LineageEmitter IS REGISTERED BY THIS MODULE (sprint-23, Story 1.5;
        removal sanctioned by Story 1.2 AC 3). DataCatalogLineageEmitter is
        still shipped but is deprecated and de-registered, for two reasons:
        (1) its only constructor takes three arguments, so ServiceLoader threw
        ServiceConfigurationError on it — an error AutoConfig swallowed, so the
        runtime silently fell back to NoOpLineageEmitter and the adapter had
        emitted nothing for months; and (2) it writes Data Catalog tags, and
        Data Catalog began its phased shutdown on 2026-06-01. Removing the
        registration is behaviour-identical to the swallowed error and stops
        the module advertising an emitter that never emitted. The replacement
        over the Data Lineage API (datalineage.googleapis.com) is blocked
        offline: google-cloud-datalineage is not present in ~/.m2 and this
        build runs mvn -o.

com.enrichmeai.culvert:data-pipeline-aws-athena 0.3.0 发布, AWS Athena adapter for the Culvert framework. Sprint-21 module (epic
        #144, T21.5, issue #149). Implements the Warehouse contract over AWS
        Athena (SDK v2): query/execute via StartQueryExecution + polling +
        paginated GetQueryResults, tableExists via GetTableMetadata, copy via
        CTAS, loadFromUri via a run-scoped external staging table. Also
        implements JobControlRepository as an append-only ledger (AD-2/AD-3):
        every state change is an INSERT INTO, reads project per run_id with the
        earliest terminal state winning. merge() and cleanupPartialLoad() are
        honestly unimplemented - Athena has no MERGE and no DELETE outside
        Iceberg-backed tables; both throw rather than degrade (see class
        Javadocs).
